primary_route: Proposed acute isogenic p53 depletion and near-endogenous rescue, separate caffeine perturbation, longitudinal and fixed cell-cycle/death measurements.

checks.quote: # Proposed protocol: causal test of p53-dependent, damage-induced G1 arrest
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols to select conditions and check transfer to this system.

checks.quote: Engineer all expressed endogenous p53 copies
checks.reason: Core tag/delivery and pulse/staining preparation remains unspecified; the calibration narrative lacks the operational quantities and procedure that sets those steps.

checks.quote: Calibrate the death measurement
checks.reason: No quantitative reference accuracy, DNA detector linearity/compensation or death-detection acceptance/failure criterion, despite useful no-analog controls.

checks.quote: sensitivity analyses for informative loss
checks.reason: No actual bounds or model for unknown outcomes. Repeating the analysis after excluding censored cells does not probe informative-loss bias in original-cohort arrest probability.

checks.quote: Vary exposure intensity or duration
checks.reason: No bounded dose/time/caffeine exploration or rule deriving bounds before the otherwise explicit confirmatory lock.

checks.quote: A positive result supports loss of arrest
checks.reason: The formal criterion is a positive intact-minus-depleted contrast. It does not require negligible residual depleted damage response; partial contribution can satisfy it and be called necessity.

checks.quote: # Proposed protocol: causal test of p53-dependent, damage-induced G1 arrest
checks.reason: Coded files and locked analysis are useful, but no complete raw-to-output manifest with cell/culture linkage, code/environment and acquisition/gating/model versions.

checks.quote: # Proposed protocol: causal test of p53-dependent, damage-induced G1 arrest
checks.reason: Strong controls, material integrity, initial physical-lesion matching distinguished from downstream p53 markers, original-cohort death-not-arrest endpoint, nested replication and prospective power. Blinded blocks, technical QC and diagnostic repair are explicit. Calibration is separate from confirmation, and necessity followed by rescue gives a sequential testing structure. Live and fixed assays corroborate one another. The formal necessity threshold and unknown-outcome handling still need correction.
